name: Flipcash USDF
oneLiner: USDF is Flipcash's dollar stablecoin and the first Coinbase Custom Stablecoin, collateralized 1:1 by USDC via Coinbase's stablecoin-as-a-service platform.
collateral: 1:1 collateralized by USDC via Coinbase's Custom Stablecoins platform; reserves managed by Coinbase infrastructure
pegMechanism: Coinbase Custom Stablecoin model: Coinbase handles issuance, redemption, custody, security, and compliance; USDF is designed to maintain a stable U.S. dollar value and relies on Coinbase-managed reserve backing and redemption mechanics
launchPhaseDetail: Debut token on Coinbase's Custom Stablecoin platform; went live 2026-05-20 on Solana, 1:1 backed by USDC, with Coinbase Onramp fiat access; serves as the settlement asset for Flipcash's user-created currencies; the on-chain reserve contract (github.com/code-payments/flipcash-program) was audited by Sec3. The Solana mint is 5AMAA9JV9H97YYVxx8F6FsCMmTwXSuTTQneiup4RYAUQ (6 decimals, pinned in the issuer's flipcash-program repository, created January 8 2026); it carried 2,875,649.80 USDF across 529 holders on September 13 2026, grew to 3,181,003.29 USDF by September 27, and fell to 2,686,924.32 USDF across 556 holders on October 25 2026. Jupiter lists one pool for the mint, created April 22 2026, with about $376 of liquidity and no price. USDF is not listed on DefiLlama's stablecoin list or on CoinGecko. In July 2026 Coinbase's exchange still listed USDF as operational-only backend testing (no trading, deposits, or withdrawals), while the token itself circulates on Solana.

dependencyReview.rationale: Flipcash states that USDF is fully backed by USDC and that deposits and withdrawals convert between the two assets. The relationship is a direct proportional collateral dependency and cannot yet be represented by a reserve composition because the pre-launch record has no separate reserve slices.

relationships.reason: USDC is the disclosed 1:1 backing asset for Flipcash USDF.

milestones.title: USDF supply reaches 3.18 million on Solana with still no market, price feed, or trading launch
milestones.description: On-chain supply at the Coinbase Custom Stablecoins mint grew about 10.6 percent in two weeks, from 2,875,650 USDF on September 13 to 3,181,003 on September 27. Jupiter lists no pair for the mint, CoinGecko has no entry, and no trading launch or platform news accompanied the growth.

listingStatusReview.reason: Missing lane: price. On October 26, 2026, DefiLlama returned a quote for the Solana mint without naming its source market, and Jupiter and Dexscreener queries did not identify one. That evidence is not enough to admit the quote (#1663).
